definitions.full: H6855. Tsipporah צִמֹּרָה proper name, feminine wife of Moses ( bird ); — Exod 2:21 ; 4:25 ; 18:2 ; Σεπφωρα (compare Lag BN 90 Anm .*). III. צפר (√ of following; compare Arabic plait, braid , Ethiopic id. ; Late Hebrew צְפִירָהֵ = rim of basket).

occurrences.englishText: Moses was content to dwell with the man. He gave Moses Zipporah, his daughter.
Then Zipporah took a flint, and cut off the foreskin of her son, and cast it at his feet; and she said, “Surely you are a bridegroom of blood to me.”
Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, received Zipporah, Moses’ wife, after he had sent her away,
